name: eda_entrants
title: Do new stations read cleaner or dirtier than the ones already there?
question: New vs existing stations (exploratory)
caption: For each city-year with both newly opened and existing valid stations, the % difference between the mean annual PM of the new stations and of the existing ones, averaged over cities by entry year, with 95% intervals. Pooled over all city-years, PM2.5: -5.8% (-11.5 to +0.2).
alt: Dot-and-interval chart by entry year: new PM2.5 stations read below the existing stations in the same city in 6 of 7 entry years shown, each with a wide interval. Pooled over all city-years, PM2.5: -5.8% (-11.5 to +0.2).
